summary: Notes that P() can also reference roles, FQCNs are mandatory, O() and RV() can produce links, and custom doc sites need the intersphinx extension to resolve these macros.
questions: Can P() be used to link to a role?
Why don't my R() and M() links resolve on my own Sphinx docs site?

answer_card.title: Role links and intersphinx
answer_card.answer_md:
- `P()` can reference roles: `P(community.sops.install#role)`. Use FQCNs (`ansible.builtin` for core).
- `O()` and `RV()` also link.
- On your own documentation site, enable the **intersphinx** extension so `R()`, `M()`, `P()`, `O()` and `RV()` become correct links.
